message.content:
Look at the infobox values: `periapsis = {{gaps |362 |600}} km
({{gaps |356 |400}}–{{gaps |370 |400}} km)` Notice: minimum perigee is 356,400 km! (Also mentioned in text: `The distance between the Moon and Earth varies from around 356,400 km (perigee)...`). Now let's check Eliud Kipchoge's marathon record pace / time on Wikipedia via script. ```python cmd = '''python -c " import urllib.request, json req = urllib.request.Request('https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&prop=revisions&rvprop=content&titles=Eliud_Kipchoge&format=json', headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'}) with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp: data = json.loads(resp.read().decode('utf-8')) pages = data['query']['pages'] pid = list(pages.keys())[0] content = pages[pid]['revisions'][0]['*'] lines = [l for l in content.split('\\n') if 'marathon' in l.lower() or 'record' in l.lower() or '2:' in l] print('\\n'.join(lines[:30])) "''' res = await run_command(cmd) print(res[:3000]) ```
